purpose: Canonical discoverability and activation inventory for the owner-approved GitHub-side integrations. Status describes repository implementation, not an assertion that external credentials or services are connected.

integrations.name: Grok / xAI
integrations.notes: Explicit invocation only; paid routes require budget preflight.

integrations.name: OpenRouter
integrations.notes: Explicit invocation only; paid routes require budget preflight.

integrations.name: Ollama
integrations.notes: Local service must be running in the execution environment; no remote Ollama host is configured.

integrations.name: Remote MCP integrations
integrations.notes: Use explicit endpoint and tool allowlists; no endpoints are preconfigured.

integrations.name: n8n-MCP
integrations.notes: Needs an authorized n8n endpoint and integration-specific setup; source/package presence is not a live connection.

integrations.name: 21st Magic MCP
integrations.notes: Source and npm proxy are present. Stays disabled until the owner sets API_KEY_21ST from https://21st.dev/mcp. Keys shown in videos are not usable.

integrations.name: GSAP
integrations.notes: Animation timelines for the website team.

integrations.name: Lenis
integrations.notes: Smooth scroll for the website team. Used with GSAP.

integrations.name: React Bits
integrations.notes: Copy one animated component. MIT plus Commons Clause. Do not resell the library.

integrations.name: taste-skill
integrations.notes: Design skill for the website team. Does not copy Manus, GPT, Grok, or any other product.

integrations.name: Hallmark
integrations.notes: Anti-slop design skill for a new page. Version 2. Does not copy another product.

integrations.name: Impeccable
integrations.notes: Polish and redesign skill for the website team.

integrations.name: Motion
integrations.notes: React section animation in tools/website. The clip calls this Framer Motion.

integrations.name: Scrapling
integrations.notes: Research helper for pages you are allowed to read. Not a design system. Core library scrapling 0.5 is in .tools/venvs/website-research. Browser extras are not installed.

integrations.name: PixelRAG
integrations.notes: Research helper. Source and skill only. Core package requires Python 3.12. No Wikipedia index and no model weights.

integrations.name: Heretic
integrations.notes: Source only. Do not run it and do not remove a model's refusals. Not a website tool.

integrations.name: h4cker
integrations.notes: Full ethical-hacking reference library for server security. Kept out of the website team. Do not run exploit material.

integrations.name: LightRAG
integrations.notes: Knowledge store/model/embedding configuration is required; not yet wired as a semantic RAG adapter.

integrations.name: Notion controller
integrations.notes: Requires a Notion integration token and the target page/database to be shared with that integration. append-text is explicit and mutating.

integrations.name: Files and semantic RAG
integrations.notes: Repository tool searches local Markdown/text. Semantic embedding/vector-store connector remains open; LightRAG source and package are configured for Codespaces.

integrations.name: Video/browser workflow
integrations.notes: No browser session or video generation provider is connected by this catalog. n8n-MCP can be activated after endpoint configuration.

integrations.name: Budget policy
integrations.notes: Paid model routes require explicit limit/spend environment values and pause on exhausted budget unless explicit owner override. Spend accounting itself is externally supplied and is not automatically measured.

integrations.name: Approval and audit controls
integrations.notes: External side effects still require runtime-specific approval implementation and audit evidence.

integrations.name: Emergency stop
integrations.notes: Do not infer model router shutdown from the app's emergency-stop UI; runtime enforcement must be separately verified.

integrations.name: L1B3RT4S
integrations.notes: Source is available as a pinned submodule; research corpus is not automatically executed or used to bypass service safeguards.

integrations.name: BlackEye
integrations.notes: Phishing and credential harvesting are excluded; no runnable workflow is included.

integrations.name: Blackbox
integrations.notes: No exact repository URL was established in the available project record. Similar names are not treated as interchangeable.

integrations.name: God's Eyes
integrations.notes: Exact source identity remains unverified.

integrations.name: Arrow EA
integrations.notes: Exact source identity remains unverified.
